marketplace.name: dev-digest-ai-marketplace
marketplace.description: DevDigest AI-engineering harness: reusable skills, agents, hooks and SDD workflows for Claude Code

plugins.name: sdd-engineering
plugins.description: Spec-driven development pipeline: from a raw idea to a reviewed pull request, with TDD in between.
plugins.author: AI Engineering
overview: A pipeline of skills that takes a feature from a raw idea to a merged pull request: interview, specify, clarify, design, data model, API contract, tasks, implement, review and ship.
Each stage writes a reviewable artifact under docs/features/<slug>/, so the next stage reads a file instead of guessing. Implementation runs strict test-driven development through dedicated agents.

components.name: interview
components.description: Socratic interview that turns a raw idea into a written idea brief.

components.name: specify
components.description: Turn an idea into a reviewed spec with user stories, acceptance criteria and NFRs.

components.name: clarify
components.description: Find and resolve ambiguities in a spec before design starts.

components.name: design
components.description: Write an arc42 architecture document with C4 diagrams and ADRs.

components.name: data-model
components.description: Design the data model and generate forward and rollback migrations.

components.name: api
components.description: Derive an OpenAPI contract from the data model and sequence diagrams.

components.name: tasks
components.description: Break a designed feature into tasks of a day or less, with a dependency graph.

components.name: implement
components.description: Implement tasks with test-driven development: red, green, refactor, gate.

components.name: review
components.description: Independent review of an implemented feature against its acceptance criteria.

components.name: ship
components.description: Verify the feature, write the changelog and open the pull request.

components.name: test-author
components.description: Writes the failing test first for one task, the red step of TDD.

components.name: implementer
components.description: Makes the failing test pass with minimal code, then refactors while staying green.

components.name: reviewer
components.description: Read-only reviewer: acceptance-criteria compliance first, code quality second.

components.name: devils-advocate
components.description: Hunts for ambiguities in a spec and failure modes in an idea.

components.name: lint-changed
components.description: Runs the project linter on files Claude just changed and reports failures back.

plugins.name: engineering-paved-path
plugins.description: Shared engineering conventions: code style, testing, commit messages and safe shell defaults.
plugins.author: Platform Team
overview: The conventions every other plugin builds on. Skills here are the single home for shared engineering rules: other plugins depend on this one instead of copying them.
Two hooks keep sessions safe: a shell guard that blocks destructive commands, and a session-start summary of the paved path.

components.name: react-best-practices
components.description: React component, hook and state-management conventions with a review checklist.

components.name: typescript-conventions
components.description: Strict TypeScript settings, naming, error handling and module boundaries.

components.name: commit-messages
components.description: Write Conventional Commits messages and split changes into reviewable commits.

components.name: testing-pyramid
components.description: Choose the right test layer and write tests that fail for the right reason.

components.name: guard-shell
components.description: Blocks destructive shell commands, such as recursive deletes or force-pushes to protected branches, before they run.

components.name: paved-path-summary
components.description: Adds a short summary of the paved-path conventions to the session context.

changes: The shell guard also blocks force-pushes to protected branches.

plugins.name: research-tools
plugins.description: Web and codebase research agents that return cited, dated findings.
plugins.author: AI Engineering
overview: Agents and skills for answering questions with evidence: every finding comes with a source, a date and the query that found it.
Use it for market and competitor research, technology comparisons, or mapping an unfamiliar codebase before you change it.

components.name: researcher
components.description: Clean-context researcher that answers one question with a cited table of sources.

components.name: codebase-explorer
components.description: Maps an unfamiliar codebase: modules, patterns and where similar features live.

components.name: deep-research
components.description: Plan, run and synthesize multi-source research into a narrative report with citations.

components.name: competitive-analysis
components.description: Compare competing products feature by feature and find the gap your idea fills.

plugins.name: architecture-review
plugins.description: Review designs and record decisions: ADRs, design critiques and blast-radius checks.
plugins.author: Architecture Guild
overview: Lightweight architecture governance for teams without a dedicated architect: write decisions down, and have a clean-context critic check designs before they are built.

components.name: adr
components.description: Write an Architecture Decision Record with options, trade-offs and consequences.

components.name: design-review
components.description: Critique a design document for coherence, gaps and unstated constraints.

components.name: critic
components.description: Clean-context critic that checks a design for cross-section drift.

components.name: arch-review
components.description: Run a full architecture review of the current branch.

plugins.name: github-workflow
plugins.description: Pull request, issue and release workflows on GitHub through the official GitHub MCP server.
plugins.author: Platform Team
overview: Open, review and ship pull requests without leaving the session. Release notes are drafted from the pull requests merged since the last tag.

userConfig.description: Personal access token with the repo scope.

components.name: github
components.description: Official GitHub MCP server: issues, pull requests, reviews and releases.

components.name: pr-review
components.description: Review a pull request diff and post inline comments.

components.name: release-notes
components.description: Draft release notes from the pull requests merged since the last tag.

components.name: ship-pr
components.description: Push the branch, open a pull request from the template and request reviewers.
